title: Reactions in Aqueous Solution
seo_title: Grade 10 Physical Sciences: Reactions in Aqueous Solution Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 10 Physical Sciences: Reactions in aqueous solution
standard_text: Ions in aqueous solution: dissolving and dissociation; electrolytes and conductivity; precipitation reactions; tests for ions; acid–base and redox reactions as types of reactions in water. (summary of CAPS Physical Sciences, Grade 10, Chemistry: Reactions in aqueous solution)
meta_desc: Free Grade 10 Physical Sciences worksheets (CAPS): dissolving and ions, electrolytes, precipitation, tests for ions and acid–base reactions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Ionic compounds dissociate into ions in water.
key_sub: A precipitate is an insoluble solid that forms in a solution.
body_html:
How to think about it

When an ionic compound dissolves, water molecules surround and separate the ions: NaCl(s) → Na⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq). Solutions with many ions are good electrolytes and conduct electricity well.

In a precipitation reaction two solutions mix and an insoluble salt forms: Ag⁺(aq) + Cl⁻(aq) → AgCl(s), a white precipitate. Tests for ions use precipitates, such as barium chloride for sulfate. In acid–base reactions H⁺ ions react with OH⁻ ions to form water.

Example

What forms when silver nitrate is added to sodium chloride solution?

Ag⁺ and Cl⁻ meet

Answer: a white precipitate of silver chloride

Example

Does sugar solution conduct electricity?

Sugar does not form ions.

Answer: no

Common mistakes

  • Thinking all salts dissolve in water.
  • Writing a solid as (aq).
  • Thinking pure water is a good conductor.

faq.a: Add silver nitrate (and nitric acid); a white precipitate shows chloride.

items.q: 22,0 g of H₂SO₄ is dissolved in water to make 250 mL of solution. What is the molarity? (molar mass 98 g mol⁻¹)
items.e: Moles = 22,0 ÷ 98 = 0,224 mol; M = moles ÷ volume in L = 0,224 ÷ 0,250 = 0,898 mol·dm⁻³.

items.q: A solution contains 2,50 mol of ethanol and 7,00 mol of water. What is the mole fraction of ethanol?
items.e: x = n(ethanol) ÷ (total moles) = 2,50 ÷ 9,50 = 0,263.

items.q: Why is salt spread on icy roads?
c: it lowers the freezing point of water
items.e: Depression of freezing point.

items.q: 16,5 g of CaCl₂ is dissolved in 100 g of water. What is the molality of the solution? (molar mass 111 g mol⁻¹)
items.e: Molality = moles of solute ÷ mass of solvent in kg = 0,149 ÷ 0,100 = 1,49 mol kg⁻¹.

items.q: When instant coffee dissolves in hot water to make coffee, what is the solvent?
items.e: The solute dissolves; the solvent does the dissolving; together they make the solution.

items.q: 19 g of H₂SO₄ is dissolved in 330 g of water. What is the mass percentage of the solute?
